# add first screen
a onPreEnter
a onEnter
current a
screenNames @["a", "b", "c"] children @["a"]
# current = b
b onPreEnter
a onPreLeave
isActive true children @[]
# current = c while a->b is running
c onPreEnter
b onPreLeave
c onEnter
b onLeave
after current c isActive false children @["c"]
# current = c again (no-op)
